description: This is a C source file for a Linux kernel module related to PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) driver functions, including proc filesystem interface and debug control for VR9 platform.

methods.name: proc_file_create
methods.description: Creates proc entries for memory and pp32 control interfaces.

methods.name: proc_file_delete
methods.description: Removes proc entries for memory and pp32 control interfaces.

methods.name: sb_addr_to_fpi_addr_convert
methods.description: Converts buffer address to FPI address, using SB_BUFFER macro if address is below 0xFFFF.

methods.name: proc_write_mem
methods.description: Handles writing commands to read/write memory via proc interface.

methods.name: proc_read_pp32
methods.description: Reads debug and status information of PP32 cores, with different implementations based on configuration.

methods.name: proc_write_pp32
methods.description: Handles control commands for PP32 cores via proc interface, including start, stop, step, freeze, unfreeze, and breakpoints.

methods.name: strincmp
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison for a specified length.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Extracts tokens from input string for parsing commands.

methods.name: get_number
methods.description: Parses a number (decimal or hex) from input string.

methods.name: ignore_space
methods.description: Skips whitespace and delimiters in input string.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_test_init
methods.description: Kernel module initialization function, creates proc entries.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_test_exit
methods.description: Kernel module cleanup function, deletes proc entries.
